references.text: Describes the same forty-year journey in the wilderness, where God tested Israel and provided for them with manna and clothes that did not wear out
Repeats that God led the people for forty years in the wilderness and that their clothes and shoes did not wear out
The Lord your God carried you as a father carries his child, all the way you went
The Israelites ate manna for forty years, until they reached the border of Canaan
Nehemiah confirms that God sustained the people for forty years in the wilderness, and they lacked nothing
The Lord is my shepherd; I lack nothing - the same theme of God's complete care
The Lord knows the way of the righteous - parallel to how God knew Israel's journey
The Lord was with Joseph and made everything he did succeed - the same theme of God's blessing over work
Jesus teaches that God knows what we need and will provide for us, just as He did for Israel in the wilderness
My God will supply all your needs according to His riches in glory in Christ Jesus
